activation.changes_after_activation: create a new protocol version and restart formal collection

amendment.reason: freeze the deterministic VLM request and bounded unload-confirmation repair after G6 v3 closed on a system-under-test timeout and the repaired repository path passed separate target validation

hypotheses.responsiveness: Moving the same slow workload behind the Phase 1 execution boundary reduces periodic-probe disruption and keeps the asynchronous p95 of per-run maximum gaps within the preregistered practical bound.
hypotheses.workload_noninferiority: The asynchronous boundary preserves fixed-input workload performance within the preregistered ten-percent noninferiority margin.
hypotheses.lifecycle: All measured runs preserve bounded ownership, complete shutdown and zero stale consumption.

confirmatory_endpoints.decision_rule: all responsiveness, workload-noninferiority and lifecycle criteria must pass for every workload
confirmatory_endpoints.multiplicity: intersection-union decision; no claim passes unless every preregistered workload criterion passes

bootstrap.procedure: resample five sessions with replacement, then resample six paired blocks with replacement within each selected session; retain each sync/async pair
